title.zh: Coinbase Appeals Connecticut Ruling Over Sports Event Contracts
title.en: Coinbase Appeals Connecticut Ruling Over Sports Event Contracts

current_state.zh: Coinbase has appealed a Connecticut court ruling over its sports event contracts, escalating its jurisdictional fight with state regulators over whether prediction-market style products fall under federal derivatives oversight or state gaming law.
